meta.title: Every Season — Vocabulary Set 4
meta.subject: English Vocabulary
meta.description: Sentence completion quiz using all 16 target words from 'Every Season' in context.

questions.question: My favorite _______ is spring because I love when the flowers start to grow.
questions.explanation: A 'season' is one of the four times of the year. The sentence refers to spring as a favorite season.

questions.question: In summer, you can wear a straw hat to block the hot sun.
questions.explanation: True. Straw hats are lightweight and have wide brims to keep you cool under the summer sun.

questions.question: In spring, grass grows _______ and speckled eggs fill nests.
questions.explanation: Grass grows green in spring when there is plenty of rain and sunlight.

questions.question: We wear winter ice skates and mittens in summer.
questions.explanation: False. Skates and mittens are for cold winter weather, not hot summer days.

questions.question: We saw a small, lizard-like _______ slithering near the wet rocks.
questions.explanation: A salamander is a damp-living amphibian that looks like a lizard and slithers under rocks.

questions.question: Bright yellow _______ open up early in spring, followed by purple lilacs.
questions.explanation: Daffodils are yellow trumpet-shaped flowers that bloom in early spring.

questions.question: The bird built a strong _______ nest out of grass and small twigs.
questions.explanation: 'Woven' describes how the nest is built by crossing pieces of grass and twigs over and under each other.

questions.question: Sort these words into Spring words or Winter words:
questions.explanation: Crocuses, daffodils, and lilacs are spring flowers. Winter is a season, and icicles are ice structures that form in winter.

questions.question: A 'speckled' egg is covered with spots.
questions.explanation: True. 'Speckled' means marked with small spots, like a bird's egg.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show how we walk on summer grass:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'We go barefoot in summer.' Walking barefoot on warm grass feels nice.

questions.question: In _______, leaves turn orange and fall as the cold wind whips.
questions.explanation: Autumn (also called fall) is the season of falling leaves and cooler winds.

questions.question: Early spring flowers called _______ pop up suddenly through the grass.
questions.explanation: Crocuses are small cup-shaped flowers that are among the first to appear in spring.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe what butterflies do:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'In summer butterflies flutter and land.' (Wait! Let's check the capitalization of the first word: 'In'. Yes, 'In summer butterflies flutter and land' matches the words).

questions.question: Red leaves fall from the maple tree in spring.
questions.explanation: False. Leaves turn red and fall from the maple tree in autumn, not spring.

questions.question: Which of these sentences is correct?
options: Icicles melt in the freezing cold of winter.
Salamanders fly high in the autumn wind.
You can wear a straw hat in summer to stay cool.
Speckled nests are made of hard ice.
questions.explanation: You wear straw hats in summer to block the sun. Icicles grow (not melt) in winter. Salamanders crawl (not fly). Nests are woven of twigs (not ice).
